| Source                                      | What it provides                                                                                     | Main limitation                                                                                    | Our integration                  |
| ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| **Official Blizzard Battlegrounds catalog** | Visible live roster, text, stats, tribes, tiers, and some form links                                 | Live rather than build-pinned; not a complete mechanics specification                              | **Implemented** in `hsbg_data`   |
| **Installed Hearthstone client**            | DBF records, tags, strings, normal/golden links, subsets/pool definitions, assets, and enum metadata | Client data does not completely reveal server behavior or which server-controlled gates are active | **Implemented** through `hsdump` |
| **HearthstoneJSON / HearthSim hsdata**      | Build-and-locale-specific structured card data, stable IDs, tags, and form relationships             | Derived from the client—not an independent observation of gameplay                                 | **Implemented** in `hsbg_data`   |
| **Official Battle.net Hearthstone API**     | Another official structured card-data interface                                                      | Overlaps with catalog data; not an executable rules API                                            | **Not integrated**               |
